d:
The Cavaliers defeated the Bulls, 126-115 tonight in Cleveland. Donovan Mitchell contributed a team-high 39 points to go with 4 rebounds 4 assists and 3 steals, with Tyrese Proctor of the Cavaliers adding an additional 17 points (6-13 FG, 2-6 3P) in the game. Norman Powell finished with a team-high 27 points along with 6 assists for the Bulls in the losing effort. The Cavaliers improve their record to 8-7 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 3-10 for the season.
